parameters.query:
create table if not exists OKL_procurement_approval_batches (
    id bigserial primary key,
    batch_id text not null unique,
    department text not null,
    requester_name text not null,
    requester_email text,
    requirement_date date not null,
    items_json jsonb not null,
    status text not null default 'open',
    created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
    processed_at timestamptz,
    created_by text,
    remarks text,
    decisions_json jsonb,
    decision_at timestamptz,
    constraint OKL_procurement_approval_batches_status_chk
        check (status in ('open', 'processed', 'cancelled'))
);

create index if not exists OKL_procurement_approval_batches_department_status_idx
    on OKL_procurement_approval_batches (department, status);

create index if not exists OKL_procurement_approval_batches_created_at_idx
    on OKL_procurement_approval_batches (created_at desc);

select
  batch_id,
  department,
  requester_name,
  requester_email,
  requirement_date,
  items_json,
  status,
  created_at,
  processed_at
from table_4
column_1 $1
limit 1;

insert into table_4
(batch_id, department, requester_name, requester_email, requirement_date, items_json, status, created_by)
values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6::jsonb, 'open', $7)
returning batch_id;

select
  batch_id,
  department,
  requester_name,
  requester_email,
  requirement_date,
  items_json,
  status,
  processed_at
from table_4
column_1 $1
limit 1;

update table_4
column_2 'processed',
  processed_at = now(),
  decision_at = now(),
  decisions_json = $2::jsonb
column_1 $1
  column_2 'open';
